description: Return the 19 curatorial departments at The Metropolitan Museum of Art, each with its numeric departmentId and display name — the valid values for the departmentId filter on met_search_collections and met_list_objects.
name: met_list_departments

departments.description: All 19 curatorial departments at The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

departmentId.description: Numeric department ID for the departmentId parameter of met_search_collections and met_list_objects.

displayName.description: Human-readable department name (e.g., "European Paintings", "Egyptian Art", "Arms and Armor").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_blocked`: The Met API's firewall refused the request with HTTP 403 — it blocks this server's address, not one endpoint. `upstream_unavailable`: The Met API answered HTTP 500, 502, 503, or 504 until the retry ladder ran out — an outage on its side. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The call's time budget ran out, retries and backoff included, before the Met API returned a successful response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: List Met Departments
